issue_request: FHIR-15524 was a Published FHIR-core QuestionnaireAnswers change request resolved Not Persuasive with Modification. It asked for an attribute on QuestionnaireResponse to indicate the language in which the patient completed the survey; the approved disposition was to use inherited QuestionnaireResponse.language and add explanatory guidance to the notes section.
initial_application: Git commit e4ad0ecfef added the QuestionnaireResponse notes bullet for the inherited language element. The original text had a spelling typo, later corrected by commit 31ac17f13c for FHIR-25940, and the current notes source preserves the intended guidance.
additional_context: QuestionnaireResponse is an active current-build resource in source/fhir.ini. Resource.language remains inherited from Resource, defined as the base language in which the resource is written and bound to IETF language tags. Jira, Zulip, and Confluence searches found no directly relevant later core decision that supersedes this guidance.
